description: This file defines a mock class 'MediaPipelineCapabilitiesMock' for the 'IMediaPipelineCapabilities' interface, used in testing media pipeline capabilities within the Rialto server component. It includes mock methods for retrieving supported MIME types and checking MIME type support.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilitiesMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of IMediaPipelineCapabilities for testing purposes.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Mock method to retrieve supported MIME types for a given media source type.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Mock method to check if a specific MIME type is supported.
